key.name: keyboard-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut to toggle the Strata UI visor

key.name: visor-edge
key.summary: Screen edge the visor is anchored to

key.name: card-width
key.summary: Width of a shelf card in pixels

key.name: page-size
key.summary: Number of history items fetched per page
key.description: The shelf loads this many cards on open and again each time the horizontal scroll nears the end. The full table never sits in JS memory.

key.name: max-history
key.summary: Maximum number of clipboard history items to keep
key.description: Also bounds search: SearchHistory returns up to this many matches. Reuses Strata's key (the rest of the reused keys land with the prefs UI in 008).

key.name: move-activated-to-top
key.summary: Move a picked item to the front of the shelf when selected
key.description: Reuses Strata's key. When on, copying an item moves its card to position 1 for immediate feedback; the daemon also re-ranks it by recency on the re-copy.

key.name: theme
key.description: Applied by toggling a CSS class on the visor (class-toggle), never by re-parsing markup. Auto follows the system light/dark preference (org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme); Light and Dark force a fixed theme.

key.name: max-text-mb
key.description: Reuses Strata's key. Text payloads larger than this are not stored by the daemon.

key.name: max-image-mb
key.description: Reuses Strata's key. Image payloads larger than this are not stored by the daemon.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.summary: App WM-class substrings excluded from clipboard history
key.description: Reuses Strata's key. Items copied while one of these apps has keyboard focus are dropped (the live ItemAdded filter lands in feature 009). Case-insensitive substring match.
